adjudication: The suggested 8-12GiB compressor threshold is not adopted: successful earlier controls started with21.21GiB and24.07GiB, while the failed replay started22.73GiB. Baseline compressor alone did not distinguish them. Existing pressure/free guards remain unchanged and the model outercap is tightened48GiB. Record compressor and host inventory; no unrelated process termination.
Compare total required blocking as read+copy+wait; histogram read bins alone are not cross-mode totals.
Real staged projections cover48routed expert visits,40uniqueexperts,perlayer onlayers3and44; all288bytecomparisons use read_payload.

limitations: Four trials in ABBA order on one short prompt, two per mode; background load is not controlled.
Compare the 128-row arms within this sweep; the earlier 160-row archive comparison is a different profile.
Required blocking includes read, copy, and staging-lock waits. Histograms contain only read time.
Forced input tokens match, but asynchronous readiness, executed precision, and greedy predictions can differ.
This replay supplies no autoregressive answer-quality score or evidence of the 15-30 TPS target.
System swap counters cover the whole desktop and memory counters overlap.
Real staged validation covers 48 routed visits (40 unique experts) per layer on L3 and L44 through GPU projections.
The separate 288-row byte check uses read_payload and does not exercise staged fill.
The second scattered control measured0.711TPS versus3.319TPS in the first, with large increases in both read and route windows. Do not present aggregate percentage change as a reliable speedup.

Decode process disk reads were about36.5GB in staged trials versus46.5GB in scatter trials, against roughly48GB of requested base plus refinements. Cache effects and asynchronous counter boundaries also affect this comparison.
comparison_status: Unstable scattered-read control; arithmetic changes are descriptive and not causal effect estimates.
